name: plan-explainer
description: Build and publish a self-contained HTML explainer page — UI mocks, decision cards, a Copy-answers button — for plan approval and visual questions.

interface.shortDescription: Visual plan and decision pages the human reviews from any device.
interface.longDescription: Fills a skeleton HTML page with UI mocks built from the app's real design tokens, before/after behavior, and open questions as selectable cards with a Copy-answers button, then publishes it to a permanent unlisted URL.
